711190101.text: "...Present the jade at dawn, and glorious halls at dusk; The pleased spirits descend, with fortune and blessings eternal..."

711190102.text: "...Scent of orchids, fragrance of flower, the jade cauldron and golden goblet; the fragrance wafting towards the <color=#00E1FFFF>east</color>, burning incense towards the <color=#00E1FFFF>west</color>..."

711190103.text: "...<color=#00E1FFFF>Build an altar</color> for sacrifice, sweet wine libation and imbibation; shining brightly for thousands of years, illuminating all directions..."
